get.description: Example searches for the landing page, from the data being served.
Parcels matching a county ID (dashed, compact or partial), block-lot or address.
Transit stops, parks, schools and neighborhood outlines (EPSG:4326).
Every parcel's geometry (EPSG:4326) with its band and score. Ranks arrive with search.
The city's 90 neighborhoods, with how many candidates each has in the data.

Report header, the engine's analysis, and where its facts came from, by county ID.

With `product_type` (and optionally `units`), the engine scores that building instead of
its own pick, from the lot's stored facts. Lots without stored facts keep the stored pick,
and `program` comes back empty.

One finding (`flag.<flag id>`) or the approvals option (`option.with_relief`) of the
lot's report, for the same building type as the report (`product_type`, `units`).

post.description: Candidates that pass every filter, ranked; near misses and a suggestion when empty.
Plain-language description to search filters. It never searches, scores or ranks.
